feedback: Measured oscillation frequency of 87.044 MHz using a Saleae Logic Pro 8 connected to osc_div_4 / uo_out[2] (measured 21.761 and multiplied by 4)

Used Keysight HD3 scope on the divide by 8 output pin. Histogram showed 91.782ns mean period with standard deviation 32.6ps. Multiply by 8 to get 87.16MHz internal frequency. Measured at 19.8 C after waiting 10 minutes.
I used an  ADLAM2000 oscilloscope on channel one.  Dividing by 8 gave an average frequency of 10.601 MHz, and dividing by 4 gave 21.235MHz.  The ADALM could not detect divide by 2 or 1.
Measured a frequency of 10.829 MHz (osc_div_8), using an AD2 on the uo_out3 pin, with a peak-to-peak voltage of 3.261V.
